info.name: A brave Warrior to defeat King Clang appears!

descriptions.inProgress: Complaining Riel soon lightens up and says that a brave warrior must appear to rescue the beautiful girl in distress. Therefore, she asks me to take the role of the warrior and defeat King Clang. What have I done to get myself into these situations!? I'm not the warrior type, but the least I can do is help defeat #rKing Clang#k. \n\n#o5220000# #r#a21611##k
descriptions.completed: Defeated King Clang and came back to Riel. Riel joyfully says that a brave warrior saved her. It really wasn't for her sake, but Florina Beach is finally back to its peaceful state.
